```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(DHARMa)
library(fitdistrplus)
library(gamlss)
```


```{r}
citation_data <- read_delim("example_citation_data_final.csv") %>%
  mutate(source = str_to_upper(source)) %>%
  mutate(n.citations = 1) %>%
  select(final.year, source, journal.pub.year, n.citations, pub.title)

journal_metrics <- read_delim("final_df.csv") %>%
  rename("avg_citable_2yr" = "sum_citable_2yrs", "source" = "journal_name") %>%
  select(-c(source_sheet))
```

# Test Case Groundtruthing with CJZ
```{r}
test_citation_data <- citation_data %>%
  filter(source == "CANADIAN JOURNAL OF ZOOLOGY") %>%
  filter(journal.pub.year >= 2014)

test_journal_metrics <- journal_metrics %>% 
  filter(source == "CANADIAN JOURNAL OF ZOOLOGY") %>%
  filter(year >= 2014)

cit_2yr_sum_test <- test_journal_metrics %>%
  left_join(test_citation_data, by = "source") %>%
  filter(journal.pub.year == year - 1 | journal.pub.year == year - 2) %>%
  group_by(source, year) %>%
  summarise(
    citations_prev2yrs = sum(n.citations),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

final_test_journal_metrics <- test_journal_metrics %>%
  left_join(cit_2yr_sum_test, by = c("source", "year")) %>%
  mutate(citations_prev2yrs = coalesce(citations_prev2yrs, 0))


cif_test <- final_test_journal_metrics %>%
  mutate(cif = citations_prev2yrs / avg_citable_2yr)
```

# Full CIF Calculation
```{r}
citations_previous_2yr <- df2 %>%
  left_join(df1, by = "source") %>%
  filter(journal.pub.year == year - 1 | journal.pub.year == year - 2) %>%
  group_by(source, year) %>%
  summarise(
    citations_prev2yrs = sum(n.citations),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

journal_metrics_with_citations <- journal_metrics %>%
  left_join(cit_2yr_sum, by = c("source", "year")) %>%
  mutate(citations_prev2yrs = coalesce(citations_prev2yrs, 0))
write_delim(journal_metrics_with_citations, "journal_metrics_with_citations", delim = ',')

cif_calc <- journal_metrics_with_citations %>%
  mutate(cif = citations_prev2yrs / avg_citable_2yr) %>%
  filter(cif != 0, is.finite(cif)) %>%
  rename(cos.if = cif,
         jif = impact_factor) %>%
  na.omit(cif_calc)

mean_impact_factor <- cif_calc %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(
    mean.jif = mean(impact_factor, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean.cif = mean(cif, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")


write_delim(cif_calc, "cif_calc.csv", delim = ",")
```

# Testing Linear Mixed-Effects Model Assumptions
```{r}
cif_lmm_year_source <- lmer(
  cos.if ~ jif + (1 | year) + (1 | source),
  data = cif_calc)

cif_lmm_year_source_residuals <- simulateResiduals(cif_lmm_year_source)
plot(cif_lmm_year_source_residuals) # residuals are not normally distributed


cif_lmm_source <- lmer(
  cos.if ~ jif + (1 | source),
  data = cif_calc)

cif_lmm_source_residuals <- simulateResiduals(cif_lmm_source)
plot(cif_lmm_source_residuals)
```

# Finding Proper Distribution
```{r}
mGA <- histDist(cif_calc$cos.if, "GA", main = "Gamma")
plot(mGA)
fit.ga <- fitdist(cif_calc$cos.if, "gamma")
plot(fit.ga)

mPO <- histDist(cif_calc$cos.if, "DPO", main = "Double Poisson")
plot(mPO)

mGIG <- histDist(cif_calc$cos.if, "GIG", main = "Generalized Inverse Gaussian")
plot(mGIG)

mGG <- histDist(cif_calc$cos.if, "GG", main = "Generalized Gamma")
plot(mGG)

mWEI <- histDist(cif_calc$cos.if, "WEI", main = "Weibull")
plot(mWEI)

distribution_fits <- fitDist(
  cos.if,
  data = cif_calc,
  type = "realAll",
  try.gamlss = T)
distribution_fits$fits

AIC(mGIG,mGG, mWEI, mGA)
```

# GAMLSS Modelling
```{r}

cif_model_data <- cif_calc %>%
  mutate(year = as.factor(year), 
         source = as.factor(source))

cif_jif_year_model <- gamlss(cos.if ~ jif + random(year), data = cif_model_data, family = "GG") # removed source as RE due to model convergence 

wp(cif_jif_year_model)
plot(cif_jif_year_model)

cor.test(cif_model_data$jif,cif_model_data$cos.if, method = "spearman")

summary(cif_jif_year_model)

cif_jif_model <- gamlss(cos.if ~ jif, data = cif_model_data, family = "GG") 

plot(cif_model_data$cos.if, cif_model_data$jif)
cor(cif_model_data$cos.if, cif_model_data$jif) # -0.1119

# Log-based CIF Calculation
trans.cosewicif <- cif_calc %>% mutate(log.cif = log10(cos.if), log.jif = log10(jif)) 

plot(trans.cosewicif$log.cif, trans.cosewicif$log.jif)
cor(trans.cosewicif$log.cif, trans.cosewicif$log.jif)
```

# Scatter Plot
```{r}
jifplot <- ggplot(mean_if, aes(x = mean.jif, y = mean.cif)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean Journal Impact Factor (JIF)",
    y = "Mean COSEWIC Impact Factor"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme( plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      colour = "black"))
plot(jifplot)
# Creates a scatterplot to visualize the relationship between journal impact factor (mean.jif) and the calculated COSEWIC IF (cos.if). Each point represents a journal, with transparency used to reduce overplotting.

jifplot_log <- ggplot(mean_if,
                      aes(x = mean.jif,
                          y = mean.cif)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Log Mean Journal Impact Factor (JIF)",
    y = "Log Mean COSEWIC Impact Factor"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme( plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      colour = "black"))
plot(jifplot_log) 
```

```{r}
# Selecting Top 10 Journals by JIF
top10_jif <- mean_if %>%
  arrange(desc(mean.jif)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    mean.jif = formatC(mean.jif, format = "fg", digits = 3),
    mean.cif = formatC(mean.cif, format = "fg", digits = 3))
View(top10_jif)
# Selects the top 10 journals based on mean journal impact factor (mean.jif) by sorting in descending order and taking the first 10 entries. The values for mean.jif and cos.if are then formatted to three significant digits for cleaner presentation. 

top10_jif <- mean_if %>%
  arrange(desc(mean.jif)) %>%
  slice_head(n =10)
View(top10_jif)
# Extracts the top 10 journals by JIF without modifying or formatting the values. 

table_top10_jif <- top10_jif[, c("source", "mean.jif", "mean.cif")]
print(table_top10_jif)
View(table_top10_jif)
# Making sure that there's proper columns needed. 
# Subsets the dataframe to retain only the relevant columns (source, mean.jif, and cos.if) for table creation. This ensures that only the necessary variables are included in the final output. 

renamedtable_top10_jif <- table_top10_jif %>% 
  rename("Journals"=source,"Mean Journal Impact Factor (JIF)" = mean.jif, "Mean COSEWIC IF"=mean.cif) # Renamed the columns to have proper column names necessary for the final table print.
View(renamedtable_top10_jif)
# Renames the columns to more descriptive labels suitable for presentation in figures or tables. 

top10jif_table_plot <- ggtexttable( renamedtable_top10_jif,rows = NULL,  # Hide row numbers
  theme = ttheme( colnames.style = colnames_style(color = "white", fill = "steelblue", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), tbody.style = tbody_style(fill = c("white", "gray95"), hjust = 0.5))) #Found this function online. 
View(top10jif_table_plot)

top10jif_table_plot 
```


# Top 10 Mean COSEWIC IF Table
```{r}
# Selecting Top 10 Journals by COSEWIC IF
top10_cosewic <- mean_if %>%
  arrange(desc(mean.cif)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)
View(top10_cosewic)
# Selects the top 10 journals based on COSEWIC IF (cos.if) by sorting in descending order and taking the first 10 entries. The mutate() step doesn't modify values but keeps the variables explicit for consistency. 

# Subsetting Relevant Columns
table_top10_cosewic <- top10_cosewic[, c("source", "mean.jif", "mean.cif")]
print(table_top10_cosewic)
View(table_top10_cosewic)
# Making sure that there's proper columns needed. 
# Subsets the dataframe to retain only the relevant columns (source, mean.jif, and cos.if) for table creation. 

# Column Renaming
renamedtable_top10_cosewic <- table_top10_cosewic %>% 
  rename("Journals"=source,"Mean Journal Impact Factor (JIF)" = mean.jif, "Mean COSEWIC IF"=mean.cif) # Renamed the columns to have proper column names necessary for the final table print.
View(renamedtable_top10_cosewic)
# Renames the columns to more descriptive labels suitable for presentation in tables or figures. 

# Formatted Table for Visualization
top10cosewic_table_plot <- ggtexttable( renamedtable_top10_cosewic,rows = NULL,  # Hide row numbers
  theme = ttheme( colnames.style = colnames_style(color = "white", fill = "steelblue", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), tbody.style = tbody_style(fill = c("white", "gray95"), hjust = 0.5))) #Found this function online. 
View(top10cosewic_table_plot)
top10cosewic_table_plot
# Code creates a formatted table for visualization using ggtexttable(). Row numbers are removed for cleaner presentation. To improve readability, coloured headers and alternating row fills were used. 
```
